user.title: HA Sport CZ/SK
user.description: Football, ice hockey and basketball in Czechia and Slovakia: fixtures, results, tables, brackets, odds and where to watch.

data_description.base_url: Usually keep the default. Fallback addresses are tried automatically on errors.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.description: Select Sofascore competitions (leagues, cups, play-offs). Already selected ones are hidden in the dropdown. SZĽH youth and lower leagues (e.g. 6th grade) are added in Configure → SZĽH competitions.

favorites.title: Favorite teams
favorites.description: Pick your favorite teams – they get their own sensors, calendar, odds and notifications. Use search for national teams or teams from other competitions.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose when and where to receive match notifications.

data.notify_periods: Notify end of half / period / quarter
data.notify_persistent: Also show as HA persistent notification
data.notify_odds: Notify odds movement on my team
data.odds_threshold: Notify when the odd changes by

data_description.notify_before: Select multiple, or type a custom number of minutes (e.g. 45).
data_description.notify_live_interval: 0 = off. E.g. 15 sends the current score every 15 minutes.
data_description.notify_targets: E.g. notify.mobile_app_phone – the push contains a 'Watch' button linking to the stream.
data_description.quiet_start: No notifications are sent in this window (the ha_sport_notification event is still fired).
data_description.notify_score: Basketball baskets are not notified individually – use live score updates.
data_description.odds_threshold: E.g. 10 % = odd 2.00 dropped to 1.80. The ha_sport_odds_change event is always fired.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the data source (Sofascore): {error}
